mapper.select: SELECT PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO , PASSER_CODE FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION WHERE PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO = #{passIntroductionNo}

SELECT pi.PASSER_CODE, pi.PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO, a.APPLICANT_ID, a.USER_ID, rn.RECRUITMENT_NO, rn.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, rn.JOB_CODE, rn.USER_ID as COM_ID, c.COM_NAME, r.RESUME_NO, r.RESUME_NAME, i.INTRODUCTION_NO, i.INTRODUCTION_NAME, i.INTRODUCTION_CREATE_DATE, iq.QUESTION_NO, iq.QUESTION, iq.CONTENT, e.EDUCATION_NO, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.HIGHEST_EDUCATION_CODE, e.GRADUATE_YN, e.TRANSFER_YN, e.LOCATION, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION pi JOIN PASSER p ON pi.PASSER_CODE = p.PASSER_NO AND p.PASSER_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND p.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' JOIN APPLICANT a ON p.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID AND a.APPLICANT_DEL_DATE IS NULL JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE rn ON a.RECRUITMENT_NO = rn.RECRUITMENT_NO AND rn.RECRUITMENT_DEL_DATE IS NULL JOIN COMPANY c ON rn.USER_ID = c.USER_ID JOIN RESUME r ON a.RESUME_NO = r.RESUME_NO AND r.RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL JOIN INTRODUCTION i ON pi.INTRODUCTION_CODE = i.INTRODUCTION_NO LEFT JOIN INTRODUCTION_QUESTION iq ON i.INTRODUCTION_NO = iq.INTRODUCTION_NO LEFT JOIN EDUCATION e ON r.RESUME_NO = e.RESUME_NO AND e.DELETE_DATE IS NULL WHERE c.USER_ID = #{comId} ORDER BY p.PASSER_NO, iq.QUESTION_NO, e.EDUCATION_NO

SELECT 'PSIT' || LPAD(NVL(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(MAX(PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO), LENGTH('PSIT') + 1)), 0) + 1, 6, '0') FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION
INSERT INTO PASS_INTRODUCTION ( PASS_INTRODUCTION_NO, PASSER_CODE, INTRODUCTION_CODE ) SELECT #{passIntroductionNo}, p.PASSER_NO, r.INTRODUCTION_NO FROM PASSER p JOIN APPLICANT a ON p.APPLICANT_ID = a.APPLICANT_ID JOIN RESUME r ON a.RESUME_NO = r.RESUME_NO WHERE a.APPLICANT_ID = #{applicantId} AND a.RECRUITMENT_NO = #{recruitmentNo} AND p.RECRUIT_ACCEPT_YN = 'Y' AND p.PASSER_DEL_DATE IS NULL AND r.RESUME_DELETE_DATE IS NULL AND r.INTRODUCTION_NO IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PASS_INTRODUCTION pi WHERE pi.PASSER_CODE = p.PASSER_NO AND pi.INTRODUCTION_CODE = r.INTRODUCTION_NO )
